head.name: @fzlt/core/pad
head.lead: Swappable on-screen controls for touch (and mouse). One move control (an analog stick, a d-pad or move keys) under one thumb and round arcade action keys under the other, all driving controls intents through press() / steer(): game code reads down, hit and axis and never knows which scheme is on screen. Swap with setScheme() at any time. Visuals are the Board UI kit's (.bui-pad, .bui-stick, .bui-dpad, .bui-arcade + roles): mount the pad inside a .bui root. Listeners are delegated on the pad's one element (bound to the engine's signal), so a scheme swap adds none; the element goes through the ledger.

sizesNote: Measured on this build: minified and gzipped with everything it imports, the way npm run size checks the budget in CI.

blocks.aria: @fzlt/core/pad, 2.0 KB gzip: the Board UI pad drives a brick that pushes three crates home; a shoved crate slides on its own. Drive with the stick, the arrows or a tap; SHOVE to dash; SWAP for a d-pad.
